digest.component_or_area: plan-clarity structural validation and P1 readiness gates
propositions: Empty parsed Acceptance Criteria checkbox items (whitespace-only joined body) must fail standalone clarity and block plan-review P1.
Unresolved sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active execution sections must fail standalone clarity and block plan-review P1 when appearing as value assignments or line-initial expressions.
Same-line removal or negation terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without) must suppress sentinel matching to allow legitimate negation contexts.
Fenced code blocks and inline backtick code must not trigger sentinel rule violations.

A shared pure plan-structure helper must enforce the clarity floor uniformly across standalone clarity gate and plan-review P1 readiness without changing ticket-type exemptions or legacy compatibility scoring.
